notes.title: Advanced features supported by Virage Rally.
notes.notes:
Hardcore simracers may wonder what level of simulation this game provides and if their rig would work. So, here a list of some features supported by the game:
[list]
[*] multiple input devices
[*] analog handbrake
[*] triple screen
[*] you can jump the start
[*] you can setup your car and test it on the shakedown
[/list]
For more casual player, ABS and traction control can be adjusted in the difficulty settings and most game controllers are supported.

If you have any question don't hesitate to ask them on the community hub.
